correctness.rationale: Exact column-space equivalence gives subspace flags. The unique-parent condition permits recursion to a direct sum of indecomposable projectives; two-sided ideals have precisely prefix-supported columns. The Hom isomorphism Hom(e_v A,B_s)=B_s e_v, upper-block triangular endomorphisms, and Gaussian extension choices prove all remaining formulas. Independent finite-field checker verifies small cases and is expressly not substituted for the universal argument.

value.rationale: The all-forest canonical-representative theorem identifies when a noncommutative regular module is iso-multiplication, determines the embedding distributive lattice, computes explicit Hom/Aut and finite-field population formulas, and exposes star-versus-chain type-growth differences.
